data.name: Vrishabh
data.gender_notes: Vrishabh is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit word 'vrishabha', meaning 'bull'. Represents divine power and strength. The name Vrishabh carries the meaning “Bull, Divine Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Vrishabh usually hope their child will grow to embody bull, divine power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine energy and strength in Hinduism.
data.etymology: Vrishabh belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bull, Divine Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vrishabh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vrishabh holds a significant place in Hindu mythology as it is associated with the avatar of the god Vishnu - 'Vrishabhanatha'. He is shown with the head of a bull and is considered the supreme deity of the fertility and wealth. Vrishabhanatha is also believed to be the father of God Indra, the king of gods.
data.spiritual_significance: 'Vrishabh' represents the spiritual strength and power of the divine bull, symbolizing Lord Shiva and Lord Vishnu. The bull is a common symbol of the Hindu religion, signifying divine power, strength, and fertility. The name invokes the concepts of steadfastness, determination, and divine protection, bringing a sense of steadiness and tranquility to the bearer of the name. Vrishabh is also believed to invoke blessings of prosperity, wealth, and wisdom in a person's life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Vrishabh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vrisha', meaning bull. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva assumes the form of a bull (Nandi) and is known as Vrishabh. This name embodies strength, power, and divine protection.

vedic_reference.note: A name of Lord Shiva and Indra, symbolizing divine power and strength

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that The name Vrishabh is mentioned in the Rigveda as a constellation. The name Vrishabh carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Vrishabh is associated with the constellation of the same name, which is said to represent the bull Nandi.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Vrishabh remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Lakshmi Vrishabh from Hyderabad, India embodies the meaning of Vrishabh - "Bull, Divine Power". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
